reason: Conversation 1 correctly identified the heater-linked pattern, asked the two decisive questions (RCD vs MCB, cold vs hot programme), gave the safety guidance (don't keep resetting, leave unplugged, RCD is doing its job), respected the customer's refusal to remove covers, and escalated to an engineer for an insulation test with sensible part/cost context. Its weaknesses are over-firm language ('pretty much confirms' the element before testing) and a tilt-and-look suggestion that overstepped slightly, but it stayed honest about the megger test being the real confirmation. Conversation 2 hit the safety stop but offered no diagnosis, no pattern explanation, no sensible questions, and ended after one turn, leaving the homeowner with almost nothing actionable beyond 'call someone'.
